### Short Announcement to Parents

**Subject: Supporting Civilians in War Zones: Sponsored Run for the ICRC**

Dear Parents,

We are excited to announce that our school will be holding a sponsored run on [Date] to raise funds for the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The ICRC works tirelessly to provide vital humanitarian aid and protect civilians affected by armed conflicts around the world.

Your support of this event will directly contribute to life-saving assistance for those in need, such as medical care, protection, and access to essential supplies. This is an opportunity for our school community to come together to make a positive impact on global humanitarian efforts.

All proceeds from this event will be donated to the ICRC. We hope you will join us in this meaningful cause and consider sponsoring our students or participating as a runner. For more details on how to sponsor or volunteer, please see the flyer included with this announcement or visit our school office.

Thank you for your partnership in our efforts to support those affected by war.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

---

### Polite Reply to the Concerned Parent

**Subject: Re: Sponsored Run for the ICRC**

Dear [Parent's Name],

Thank you for sharing your thoughts regarding our upcoming sponsored run for the ICRC. We absolutely understand and respect your perspective on neutrality in matters of conflict and humanitarian efforts.

Please know that our intention is not to take sides in any conflict, but rather to support the fundamental principles of humanitarian aid—the protection of civilians, the need for medical assistance, and the provision of essential support regardless of their background or affiliation. The ICRC's work is governed by neutrality and impartiality; they provide aid based solely on need, without discrimination. This is not about supporting a side in a conflict, but rather about upholding the universal right to safety and dignity for all people caught in the crossfire.

Our students, as future global citizens, are learning valuable lessons about empathy, responsibility, and the importance of standing up for those who cannot help themselves. By participating in this event, we are educating them on the realities faced by civilians in war zones and encouraging them to become compassionate individuals who understand their role in a global community.

If you have any further questions or would like more information on how the funds raised will be used, please feel free to reach out to me or the school office. We value your input and welcome any continued dialogue on this important topic.

Thank you again for your thoughtful engagement.

Warm regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
